concerns.text: The plan states it will download the *full* eBird Basic Dataset (≈ 10 GB) and PRISM climate layers, storing them under `data/raw/`. The GitHub Actions free‑tier runner provides only ~14 GB of disk space, which must also accommodate intermediate files, provenance logs, and output artifacts. This exceeds the available storage and will cause the pipeline to fail before any analysis runs. Either down‑sample the eBird data to a size that fits within the runner’s disk quota or redesign the workflow to stream directly from the source without persisting the full raw files.
